profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Volpara Health
profile.summary:
In-depth software development and testing expertise, coupled with a passion for machine learning and artificial intelligence. High adaptability, strong problem-solving abilities, and excellent communication skills. Aim to drive transformative change in the ever-evolving tech landscape.

Code projects in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, and C#, but have worked with PHP, Java, and C/C++.

Supporter of clean codes and agile development.

IDE:  Vim, Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, PyCharm, IntelliJ

Backend: NodeJS, ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core, Flask, EntityFramework, NextJS, Apache, Nginx, Docker

Frontend: ReactJS, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap, SASS, HeadlessUI

AI: TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, HuggingFace, GPT, Stable Diffusion, LLaMA

Build Tools: Webpack, ViteJS

Hosting: AWS, Azure, GCP

Database: MySQL, MongoDb, SQL Server, Redis

Test Automation: Selenium, Puppeteer, Playwright 

Version Control:  Git, Github, SVN/TFS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack development using ASP.Net Core backend and React frontend in TypeScript. Led the development team for one of Volpara's products.

Accomplishments:
- Core developer to Risk Pathways, a web application leveraging Azure Cloud and built on top of ASP.NET MVC framework. Risk Pathways is used by health providers across the United States to calculate the patient’s cancer risk scores. It processes around 10,000 HL7 (data transfer standards for health information) messages per hour.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack developer that led the development of a full web application using React frontend (TypeScript) and ASP.Net Core backend (C#).

Accomplishments:
- Technical lead and point-of contact for Secured Access, an on-premise web application that serves as a portal for patient correspondence with medical facilities. The project was built using ASP.NET Core backend and React frontend in TypeScript.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
Built web applications using React and TypeScript. Some backend coding with C# and .NET Core.

Accomplishments:
- Core developer for Quest, a questionnaire web application for women with high risks of breast cancer; it is used in breast cancer centers in the United States, New Zealand, and Australia. Quest utilizes a React frontend in Typescript and ASP.NET Core as the backend.
-  Created UI-Kit, a reusable UI-Kit written in ReactJS that is used in various products and internal tools.

positions.title: Quality Consultant
positions.description:
Designed test solutions from functional requirements and use cases with HP Application Lifecycle Management (ALM). Collaborated with other members of the quality team to execute tests and track defects. Instructed junior members of the quality team on testing methodologies.

Accomplishments:
- Designed manual testing solutions for internal software tools and web applications that other teams at AT&T (specifically PMs) use for their development projects and tracking purposes.
- Performed functional, integration, and regression testing on various testing cycles and worked closely with developers to resolve defects.
- Designed testing solutions for the migration of a legacy application into a more modern application.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
positions.description:
Developed testing solutions and performed blackbox and whitebox testing on the company's web applications. Implemented fixes to minor defects in both front-end (HTML, CSS, JS) and backend (PHP).

Accomplishments:
- Performed quality assurance on various web services that reduced / eliminated defects before the features were released to production.
- Started an automated end-to-end testing solution for one of the company’s web applications using Selenium.
- Coded a tool in Python that assisted customers of the company to download course videos.
